items.question: How can I contact HoopLink support?
items.answer: Email ezekieldevstudio@gmail.com with the issue, app version and device type. Do not send passwords or login codes.

items.question: How do I start a Quick Game?
items.answer: Choose Quick Game, team names, 1–90 periods and 1–90 minutes. Starting scores default to 0:0. Tap Start Game.

items.question: How do scores and clocks work?
items.answer: Use +1, +2, +3 or −1 for scores. Start and stop each clock, adjust time, or reset the shot clock to 14 or 24. Reaching 0:00 does not end the game.

items.question: What does Reset Game do?
items.answer: Quick Game returns to its starting scores, first period and selected time. Session resets only the current matchup. Clocks stop and the shot clock returns to 24. Completed period records stay unchanged.

items.question: Can I leave and continue later?
items.answer: Yes. Home or Back saves progress without finalizing results. Use Continue Game or Continue Session after leaving, an app restart or a phone reboot. The latest successful local save is restored.

items.question: How does a three-team Session work?
items.answer: Teams rotate A–B, A–C, B–C for four periods per matchup, keeping each matchup score. Tap End Period to advance. A full Session records 12 periods.

items.question: How do I connect a Viewer?
items.answer: Open Invite and share the QR or HTTPS link. Private games require the game code. After joining, choose a display. Viewer timing can briefly differ; use the controller clock as the reference.

items.question: When are results saved?
items.answer: The first Game Clock Start records the starting score and time. End Period or End Game records the end. End Session keeps completed periods only. Leaving or 0:00 does not finalize results.

items.question: How do I share or delete results?
items.answer: Open Game Results from Home and expand a game or Session. Share includes the whole group. Delete removes only that saved result after confirmation; it never deletes a game in progress.
